verdict.rationale: PayPal's accept-payments page says merchants can "swiftly create a Payment Link to share on your website, via email, on social media, or through text. No coding skills required," which directly matches a no-code shareable payment link. Invoicing adds a related no-code path, with invoices shared via secure URL, email, or QR code on a hosted PayPal payment page. Evidence for the link itself is a single marketing sentence, so depth is thin. Missing for 10: documentation of the dashboard flow for creating links, evidence that sellers can start selling immediately (onboarding or activation steps), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
